finding: The incorrect case produced a tighter deterministic beam cluster than the correct case. Top-beam coordinate spread alone is not a monotonic uncertainty signal in this two-case feasibility pilot.
next_test: Compare deterministic beams with temperature-sampled coordinate ensembles and token confidence, then test whether a calibrated gate can route uncertain cases to an adaptive crop-and-resize pass.
claim_boundary: Selected two-case feasibility pilot on one known quarter-resolution hit and one known quarter-resolution miss. This does not estimate accuracy, calibration, or latency on the benchmark population.
